sim.title: Projection
sim.intro: Simulate how many times the suite runs per day and project the monthly and annual cost, with reservations and discounts. The figures come from the measured execution and the prices in this file.
sim.pat.perRunHint: The VM or container exists only while the suite runs: you pay per execution.
sim.pat.alwaysHint: The VM runs 24x7 (730 hours a month).
sim.pat.hoursHint: The VM is on a number of hours per day on those days; the disk stays all month.
sim.discHint: Spot or negotiated discount. Reserved prices are not discounted again.
sim.buyHint: Reservations are 24x7 commitments: they apply to the always-on and hours patterns.
sim.cap: Projected monthly and annual cost of every alternative
sim.nofitWarn: Alternatives that cannot run {runs} executions of {dur} within {h} hours a day (the suite does not fit): {n}. Their figures are shown but they are not ranked as the cheapest.
sim.noRes: This file has no reservation prices (price cache from an older version): only on-demand is offered.
sim.resNotApplied: Reservations are 24x7 commitments, so they do not apply to the per-execution pattern.
sim.containerNote: Container services are always pay-per-use: they keep the per-execution price in every pattern.
sim.be.title: Break-even
sim.be.intro: Runs per day from which keeping the VM always on ({buy}) is cheaper than paying per execution on demand.
sim.be.cap: Break-even of the always-on option against the per-execution price
sim.be.never: Does not pay off before it is full
sim.chart.title: Monthly cost vs runs per day
desc.sim: Line chart of the monthly cost against the runs per day for the {n} cheapest alternatives. Per-execution lines rise with the runs; always-on lines are flat and stop where the VM is full. A vertical marker shows {runs} runs per day. The break-even table above gives the key figures.
